title: Meta-Framework Version Manifest Schema
description: Tracks template version, features, and update history for template-based projects.

template_repo.description: URL of the template repository (for pulling updates)

installed_at.description: When this template version was installed/initialized

last_updated_at.description: When template was last updated (null if never updated)

features.description: Feature flags and capabilities available in this template version

template_directories.description: Directories that are part of the template and can be updated

project_directories.description: Directories that are project-specific and should not be overwritten

protected_files.description: Template files that should not be overwritten during updates (project customizations)
